title: Mandate, stakeholders and service envelope
acceptance: Named scope, beneficiaries, exclusions, demand and accountable service owner.

title: Requirement applicability and acceptance allocation
acceptance: Every selected baseline requirement has applicability, owner, design home and verification method.

title: High-level physical, logical and security views
acceptance: Components, connections, trust/authority/failure boundaries, data paths and assumptions are coherent.

title: Architecture decisions and allowed variations
acceptance: Alternatives, rationale, consequences, affected requirements and actual decision authority recorded.

title: Threat, co-residency and control responsibility
acceptance: Sharing at each layer, credible failures/compromises, residual risks and inherited controls are assigned.

title: Availability, recovery, capacity and location strategy
acceptance: Offered service boundaries and objectives are separated from categorization; exit and recovery constraints explicit.

title: Vendor realization and provisioning strategy
acceptance: Native realization choices and P0–P6 responsibilities are linked without assuming one universal provider.

title: Architecture review and engineering handoff
acceptance: Critical design decisions resolved or blocked by scope; signed disposition and engineering inputs available.

title: Site LLD and controlled design release
acceptance: Actual values and source references replace examples; reviewed topology and controlled revision identified.

title: Physical inventory, bill of materials and port/cable schedule
acceptance: Hardware/optic/firmware/power dependencies, rack and link endpoints, support and staging accepted.

title: Network, addressing, routes and ZIP paths
acceptance: Forward/reply routes, service endpoints, enforcement, MTU and alternate paths recorded per family.

title: Compute, storage and placement schedules
acceptance: Eligible hosts, native placement, virtual disk/data paths, copies and recovery membership are explicit.

title: Management, shared-service and trust interfaces
acceptance: Consumption/admin separation, initiating clients, role/key scope and bootstrap/recovery dependencies mapped.

title: Capacity, performance, MTU and failure calculations
acceptance: Assumptions and measured survivor capacity share units and failure basis; all bottlenecks evaluated.

title: Exact stack and operation-level automation coverage
acceptance: Products, APIs, providers, installers, hardware, entitlements and all lifecycle operations have a support disposition.

title: Build, rollback and qualification design
acceptance: Site-specific MOP, rollback/forward repair, test resources and assertion coverage reviewed before execution.

title: Engineering release and implementation handoff
acceptance: Versioned design, artifacts, credentials references, evidence plan and unresolved blockers handed over explicitly.

title: Change scope, release freeze and execution authority
acceptance: Actual change reference, immutable artifacts, scope, participants and stop authority recorded.

title: Staging and installation readiness
acceptance: Supplier/asset checks, approved installation method, facility work, recovery access and staging results accepted.

title: P0–P1 bootstrap and foundation receipts
acceptance: Trusted independent access, minimum services and verified physical/network transport precede platform consumption.

title: P2 native platform build receipts
acceptance: Installer and native resource changes match approved tuple; APIs, baseline and supported recovery observed.

title: P3 shared-service and boundary receipts
acceptance: Denied boundary paths, service clients, return routing, names/trust/backup and management separation observed.

title: Restricted qualification fixture and test campaign
acceptance: Authorized disposable scope, actual observations and supporting control paths; no production qualification assumed.

title: G4 initial operational and recovery readiness
acceptance: Owners, support, monitoring, incident paths and required restore/recovery evidence accepted before activation.

title: P4–P5 tenant build and production activation
acceptance: G0/G1/G2, applicable initial G4, current tests and valid authority precede reversible activation.

title: As-built, defect and evidence records
acceptance: Actual identities, configurations, departures, tests, evidence and owner acceptance are attributable.

title: P6 maintenance, migration and retirement
acceptance: Change requalification, fencing, retained-copy/key obligations, access withdrawal and safe disposal tracked.
